title: Coalesce per-tab full-state cut requests so N open tabs don't each capture a state cut under StateInner per repair delta
outcome:
Opus3's runtime measurement of the w-99c7 in-chain repair cut (TermAl mailbox 03723eab #3769, host 86c882dc, 15:26:50–15:55:58Z, read-only /api/diagnostics/persistence each minute):
- cutRequests +145 in 29 min, in bursts of multiples of 5, which suggests five cut-capable tabs;
- full states fell to about 1.7% of emissions (7/414), from about 12% (35/294) in the w-919a-only window.

Each tab sends its own POST /api/events/full-state mode=cut per repair delta, so N tabs cost N publish_state_locked captures under StateInner per delta. Goal: coalesce concurrent cut requests at the same base and target revision into one capture shared by all waiting requesters, without changing per-client correctness (each still receives a cut valid for its base). Measure before and after with the same counters. Related to the StateInner hold-time work (w-de6021f4b32f, w-6a3855441e24).
acceptance: Coalesce per-tab full-state cut requests so N open tabs don't each capture a state cut under StateInner per repair delta is done
